title: Sprint 1 — Linux Foundations & Shell Basics
description: Get comfortable with the terminal environment, system structure, and essential navigation concepts.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — Welcome to the Shell
tickets.description:
Explore Linux distributions and shell architecture.
Navigate the filesystem and understand your current location within the system.
Discover how to find documentation and access help for system tools.

tasks.title: Task 1.1.1 — What Is Linux?
tasks.description: Discover the core components of the Linux operating system, exploring the kernel, popular distributions, and the purpose of the shell.

tasks.title: Task 1.1.2 — Your First Commands
tasks.description: Gain confidence in navigating the filesystem, moving seamlessly between directories, and viewing their contents in detail.

tasks.title: Task 1.1.3 — Getting Help
tasks.description: Learn how to efficiently access built-in system documentation and manual pages directly from your terminal environment.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — Filesystem Hierarchy Standard (FHS)
tickets.description:
Understand the standard structure of the Linux filesystem.
Differentiate between path types and accurately identify various file types.
Effectively search for files and directories across the system.

tasks.title: Task 1.2.1 — Directory Deep Dive
tasks.description: Understand the purpose of core system directories and discover where essential configuration, operational data, and system information are stored.

tasks.title: Task 1.2.2 — File Types & Paths
tasks.description: Practice navigating the system using both full and relative paths, and learn to distinguish between different types of system files and links.

tasks.title: Task 1.2.3 — Searching the Filesystem
tasks.description: Master the ability to search for files across the system based on specific criteria such as name, size, type, and recent modifications.
